name: Kijima Shou
source: A second-year student who is the second son of the president of another famous company, as well as the vice president of the student council. Shou is a womanizer who tends to get easily bored of things; due to this, he's been in a relationship with different women, only to dump them after quickly losing interest. He is also very honest about his desires and constantly seeks out women in order to quench them, and tends to get more interested in women who don't like him.
